description: Minimal capability set for the main window, pruned in T11 from T1's candidate list. core:event:default lets the frontend listen to jobs://updated and service://status (and backs the window's own drag-drop event delivery). core:window:default and core:webview:default carry window drag-drop events (FR-4) and window control. dialog:allow-open backs the meetings-root folder picker (FR-16) and the Choose file... button (FR-7). core:app:default was in T1's candidate list but is dropped here: neither the frontend (no @tauri-apps/api/app import anywhere under src/) nor any Rust command exposes a version/about surface, so it is unused -- kept out per this task's 'confirm a flow breaks before keeping a permission' rule (nothing breaks; it stays out). No fs, shell, opener, http or process permission is granted: all filesystem work, the Explorer reveal and all HTTP happen in the privileged process behind validated commands.
